_doc: Single source of truth for experiments and money metrics. Every metric carries a 'kind': ACTUAL (measured), ESTIMATE, or ASSUMPTION. Dashboard: python dashboard/build_dashboard.py

ai_costs_eur.note: research used connector/web tools, not billed API calls

ai_cost_per_accepted_invoice_eur.note: not measured; cycle-01 estimate withdrawn as headline metric — total cost per accepted invoice is dominated by human review (research/pilot_economics.md)

experiments.hypothesis: XAUUSD SELL STOP 708 pts below a bullish daily close, TP 708 / SL 1616, has positive expectancy
experiments.method: event backtest H1 2020-2026 + D1 2006-2019 bounds; controls, permutation, 44 slices with BH-FDR, IS/OOS, ATR grid, Monte Carlo
experiments.cost_note: ~60 Twelve Data credits on existing plan; engineering time
experiments.result: WR 68.8% vs 69.5% breakeven; -0.020R/trade (CI -0.076..+0.034) after $0.30 spread; negative in independent era; cycle 02: independent re-implementation 100% match, geometry null WR 68.8% = observed, 0/125 variants t>2, walk-forward -0.013R, M5 shows H1 is optimistic
experiments.failure_reason: NO EDGE: win rate equals random-walk rate for this TP/SL and spread; negative after all cost scenarios; not robust
experiments.next_action: none; optional: send broker symbol specification for documentation only
experiments.learning_value: high: prevents losing prop challenges on a false edge; engine reusable

experiments.hypothesis: Small Spanish gestorías pay EUR 300 pilot then EUR 0.20/accepted invoice for supplier-invoice extraction at >=97% field accuracy
experiments.method: 25 conversations -> sample runs on their invoices -> paid pilot ask
experiments.result: not run (no prospects contacted, EUR 0 spent)
experiments.failure_reason: crowded (Inmatic, AutoApunte, Contarapid, Dext, a3innuva, Sage), mandatory structured B2B e-invoicing from Oct 2027/Oct 2028 (RD 238/2026), no verifiable differentiation or moat, negative service-model margin
experiments.pass: >=2 paid pilots AND accuracy >=97% AND review rate <=10%
experiments.kill: <2 paid pilots after 25 qualified conversations OR accuracy <97% after 2 iterations
experiments.next_action: none; technology test plan kept in experiments/EXP-002-test-plan.md

experiments.hypothesis: SMEs bidding on public tenders pay EUR 350-700 for an AI-drafted, human-edited memoria técnica
experiments.problem: writing scored technical proposals under deadline
experiments.method: concierge: 3 intro-priced jobs for firms bidding on open tenders
experiments.pass: >=1 paid job from 30 conversations; editing <=12 h; rating >=4/5

experiments.hypothesis: Median over-contracting saving on 3.0TD SME supplies is >= EUR 600/year
experiments.method: run energy_audit on 10 real invoice sets collected during EXP-002 conversations
experiments.next_action: depended on EXP-002 conversations; parked with it

experiments.hypothesis: Gestorías face a paid, deadline-driven problem adapting SME clients to mandatory B2B e-invoicing (RD 238/2026) that incumbents do not already cover
experiments.method: desk research: primary sources (BOE, ministerial order), incumbent offers, platform landscape; no contact
experiments.pass: a specific unserved, paid task with a named buyer and a verifiable price anchor
experiments.kill: editors/platforms already bundle it, or no paid task beyond software upgrades
experiments.next_action: owner decides whether to run cycle 03
